title: Miniforge3: imaplib module, when passed a user-controlled command, can have additional commands injected using…
description: A security vulnerability in the miniforge3 package's imaplib module allows injection of additional commands when a user-controlled command includes newlines. This flaw affects versions prior to 25.11.0.1-r6, 26.1.1.3-r4, and 26.3.2.3-r6. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 5.9 and has been fixed in the specified versions.
